references.text: Abraham prays to God for Abimelech, and God heals him. This demonstrates the power of intercession for healing.
Job prays for his friends, and the Lord restores his fortunes. An example of intercession for others.
David testifies that the Lord healed him. God is presented as the one who heals.
The Lord heals all your diseases. God's healing power is affirmed.
The Lord presents himself as your healer (רֹפְאֶךָ). The same root as רְפָא in Moses' prayer.
Moses intercedes for the people of Israel after the golden calf incident, showing his role as an intercessor.
An exhortation to pray for one another for healing. The prayer of a righteous person has great power.
Paul urges intercession for all people. The significance of intercession in the Christian life.
